verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents webhook events that notify your application of account activity, including asynchronous transaction-status updates, plus a specific sell_transaction_requote_required webhook. That covers the core idea of avoiding polling. The pack does not show signature verification or a named event catalog matching payment confirmed, payout settled, and conversion executed. A community question about the webhook event list is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: documented webhook signing/verification, explicit event types for payment confirmation, payout settlement and conversion execution, full event catalog, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, money movement emits signed webhooks — payment confirmed, payout settled, conversion executed — so my system tracks state without polling chains or dashboards

citations.quote: MoonPay can send webhook events that notify your application whenever an activity occurs on your account.
They allow you to receive alerts for asynchronous updates to transaction statuses.
Handle the sell_transaction_requote_required webhook to surface in-app requote notifications when a sell price changes.
